bagPolicy.summary: Clear bags up to 12 × 6 × 12 inches or opaque bags up to 6 × 9 inches are allowed and searched, including totes, clutches and fanny packs. Oversized bags may be checked for a fee at Guest Services.
prohibited: Oversized bags without using bag check
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: General concert parking is included in the ticket; premium and oversized parking upgrades cost extra. Accessible parking is in front of the box office off Pavilion Boulevard with a placard.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: Both drop-off and pickup use the A/B administrative parking gate off Pavilion Boulevard; follow the signs to the rideshare pickup near Premier Parking. Drivers returning for pickup should arrive 45 minutes before the show ends.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Card-only concessions sell food and drinks, with a cash-to-card kiosk in North Plaza. Guests may bring food in one clear one-gallon bag, subject to visual inspection.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Accessible parking is first come, first served in front of the box office via Pavilion Boulevard and requires a visible state-issued disability placard or plate.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The amphitheater FAQ does not publish a general re-entry rule.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Will-call tickets are collected from the venue box office with photo ID matching the purchaser name.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Gates 2 and 3 are open to all ticket types; Gate 1 serves VIP Club tickets, and Gate 4 is used mainly for large concerts. The Fast Lane next to Gate 2 needs a separate pass.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
